result:
This repo doesn't contain the upstream artifacts this skill expects (`controlled-items.md`, `change-impact.md`, `verification.md`, `ship.md`) or any existing baseline file, so I can't link to prior evidence — I'll draft the record from what you've told me and flag the gaps that need filling in before this counts as a real baseline (per the skill: don't claim acceptance where evidence is missing).

A few things worth naming as open gaps rather than glossing over:

- **"Stable so far" = ~1 hour of production observation.** That's a very short window for a model-dependency swap that changes ranking behavior — worth flagging explicitly as an accepted (not resolved) risk with a re-check trigger, not folded into "looks fine."
- **Embedding model swaps have hidden scope.** Did `embed-v2` require re-embedding existing stored vectors/indices, or are old `embed-v1` vectors still live anywhere (cache, search index, offline batch jobs)? If so, that's either in-scope or needs to be an explicit exclusion.
- **Rollback path.** "Known-good to roll back to" implies embed-v1 is still viable to revert to — is that actually true, or did the v1 model get decommissioned/index dropped, making rollback non-trivial?

Here's a draft — please fill in the bracketed items:

```markdown
# Baseline: recommendation-service v2.3.0

## Identity
- Version: v2.3.0
- Source: PR #482 (merge commit: [FILL IN SHA])
- Deployed: 2026-08-03, ~1 hour ago, production
- Recorded by: benjaminhuffer1@gmail.com

## Included (controlled items)
- Embedding model dependency: embed-v1 -> embed-v2 (pinned version: [FILL IN])
- [Any other deps/config/prompts/templates changed in this PR — FILL IN]

## Excluded / explicitly out of scope
- [FILL IN: e.g. "downstream service X still consumes embed-v1 vectors from
  cache Y until it re-embeds on its own schedule" — or state "none, full cutover"]

## Evidence
- Verification: new eval suite — precision and recall improved vs. prior
  baseline. [Link to eval report/run: FILL IN]
- Ship decision: [Link to ship.md / approval record: FILL IN]
- Change impact assessment: [Link to change-impact.md: FILL IN — did anyone
  document downstream consumers of embeddings/ranking output?]

## Accepted gaps (owner required for each)
- Production observation window at time of recording is only ~1 hour;
  eval-suite results are offline/pre-deploy, not yet confirmed against live
  traffic patterns. Owner: [FILL IN]
- [Rollback viability to embed-v1 — confirm whether old model/index is still
  available or was decommissioned. Owner: FILL IN]
- [Any other known unknowns]

## Re-check / re-baseline triggers
- Live metrics (latency, error rate, recommendation quality/CTR) diverge from
  eval-suite expectations within [FILL IN observation period, e.g. 48-72h]
- embed-v2 receives a further version bump
- Any downstream consumer is found still depending on embed-v1 outputs
- A near-miss or incident touches the recommendation pipeline
```

What's missing that I should fill in: the merge commit SHA, the eval report link, whether there's a separate ship/change-impact doc (or was approval informal, e.g. Slack/PR comment?), and the rollback-viability answer. Also — should the observation window before you'd consider this "confirmed" be 24h, 48h, something else?
